KCC.title: KCC Document Checklist

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Original and photocopy of Aadhaar of the applicant.

required_documents.name: Land Records (Khasra / Khatauni)
required_documents.description: Updated revenue records proving cultivation rights or ownership.

required_documents.name: Bank Passbook / Cancelled Cheque
required_documents.description: Active savings account details for loan disbursement.

submission_steps: 1. Visit your nearest bank branch or Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS).
2. Fill the KCC application form and attach the documents listed above.
3. Complete KYC and land verification with the bank officer.
4. After sanction, collect the KCC RuPay card and activate it.

PM-KISAN.title: PM-KISAN Document Checklist

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Must be linked with bank account for DBT.

required_documents.name: Land Ownership Proof
required_documents.description: Patwari-certified land records in the farmer's name.

required_documents.name: Bank Account with DBT
required_documents.description: Aadhaar-seeded account ready to receive instalments.

submission_steps: 1. Register or update details on pmkisan.gov.in or at the local CSC / agriculture office.
2. Upload or submit Aadhaar and land records for e-KYC.
3. Ensure Aadhaar–bank seeding via NPCI mapper.
4. Track instalment status on the PM-KISAN portal.

PMFBY.title: PMFBY Document Checklist

required_documents.name: Land / Tenancy Proof
required_documents.description: Ownership or lease documents for the insured plot.

required_documents.name: Sowing Certificate
required_documents.description: Certificate from village agricultural officer if required by state rules.

required_documents.name: Bank Passbook
required_documents.description: Account for premium debit and claim credit.

submission_steps: 1. Enrol before the cut-off date for the season via bank, CSC, or pmfby.gov.in.
2. Select crop, village, and insured area; pay the farmer share of premium.
3. Keep the acknowledgement / policy document safe.
4. Report crop loss within the notified window for claim survey.
